_comment: Recall gate for the PII benchmark (#35). Each value is the recall both detectors (SDK and gateway port) measured on dataset.v1.jsonl when the gate was set, rounded down to 2 decimals. Raise a value when a detector improves; never lower one without a security review. Keys are a category (all locales) or category@locale. person_name and postal_address are labelled but not detected, so not gated.

opt_in._comment: Recall gate for the opt-in detector prompt_shields.pii_extended.detect_pii_categories_extended, rule-based (ner=None), #351. min_recall: on dataset.v1.jsonl, on top of the default gate above, which it must also pass. min_recall_holdout: on the hand-written held-out set dataset.optin.v1.jsonl, which the rules were not tuned on. Each value is the measured recall rounded down to 2 decimals; never lower one without a security review. Detection and telemetry only: these categories must not be used for blocking until security signs off (#35).
